rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-8 INIT_T asymptote pin (near prior-off), breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t@relax1.0: 0.1->25.2,0.05->28.9,0.02->33.7dB/RMSE7.06e-3. Still climbing, now only ~2.6dB below baseline 36.3dB/5.21e-3. hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: the recon asymptotes to (near-clean FBP embed + full CG-DC) as init_t->0; it approaches but has not crossed the plain-Hann-FBP baseline. (3) ONE KNOB: init_t 0.02->0.005 (essentially prior-off; FBP embedded almost clean). (4) HYPOTHESIS: near-flat vs iter-7 or a small further gain -> pins the true init_t->0 asymptote. If it saturates at ~34-35dB just under 36.3, the DC-on wavelet recon is FBP-bounded (the CG-DC-projected near-FBP never beats the plain FBP baseline; the wavelet prior adds no value on sparse breast). (5) BUDGET ~90s. (6) iter-9 tests dc_n_cg-up at this init_t (does a stronger LSQ CG solve finally cross the baseline?).
